description: Call harvest() on the ratchet (§4.3.2): sends the staked reserve's accrued tsTON yield to the LP-governed treasury and moves no term of T. Permissionless and caller-paid, 0.17 GRAM with the change returned. Refused while an exit is open, inside the 30-day interval, and when the yield is under the dust floor.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.
